products.name: Swarming ISR Satellite Constellation
products.description: Autonomous swarming satellite architecture where satellites communicate, task each other, and act in orbit without waiting for ground station. Six satellites equipped with electro-optical, thermal, and electronic-warfare sensors.

products.name: Ground Station as a Service (GSaaS)
products.description: Global network of 70+ hardened ground stations across 6 continents, available as a service. All major frequency bands (S, X, UHF, VHF). Ultra low latency mission operations.

products.name: Mission Operations as a Service
products.description: Primary mission operator for several ISRO satellites; serves nearly all Indian space companies. Fleet-level scheduling, virtualized modems, machine-to-machine operations.

products.name: Avionics as a Service
products.description: Flight-proven satellite subsystems including onboard computers, power systems, RF payloads, communication and navigation modules. Validated through missions with ISRO and national defence agencies.

products.name: Onboard Computers & Satellite Positioning Sensors
products.description: Products include onboard computers, satellite positioning sensors, solar panels, magnetic torquers, power modules, S-Band TxRx systems, proof of life transmitters, MEMS IMU systems, reaction wheels.
